original.target_description: One year of citizen-initiated dispatched CAD calls from nine anonymized US law-enforcement agencies; descriptive frequencies, mean time on scene and dispositions for 14 call categories. No individual inferential test specified by input.

n.location: p. 260, A Multi-Agency Analysis of CAD Data
n.quote: data from nine U.S. law enforcement agencies.
n.sample_role: Law-enforcement agencies contributing one year each of CAD data; agency sample for cross-agency descriptive means, not total calls or participants. Exact analytic call denominator not established.
n.exclusions: Citizen-initiated calls only; police-self-initiated calls excluded (p. 262). Dispositions available from five agencies only (p. 265).

replication.target_description: Detroit, 2019 public-initiated 911 calls: descriptive scale and composition across six demand classes, with counts and time on scene/deployed time. No individual inferential test specified by input.

n.quote: capturing 260,000 individual public calls for service
n.sample_role: Individual public calls for service retained for descriptive analyses; rounded printed count, not a participant sample.
n.exclusions: Officer-initiated calls excluded; missing/negative response time and missing/nonpositive time on scene excluded; administrative, unknown and nondeployment descriptions removed, as were prisoner transport/warrant incidents. Spatial analyses additionally omit 2% with incomplete geography.

reported_success.quote: the results presented here provide robustness to those reported by Ratcliffe (2021) and Lum et al. (2022).

notes: Input supplies no study/test locator and only a broad descriptive topic; target_match remains unknown at individual-test level. Original and replication use descriptive frequencies, percentages and time summaries. No uniquely specified effect-size/p-value test is extractable; ES and p remain null rather than selecting arbitrary descriptive percentages. Original n refers specifically to nine agencies, not a derived or approximate combined call count; disposition sample differs. Supplied original DOI 10.1177/2f10986111211035002 returned 404. Retrieved exact title/authors under printed DOI 10.1177/10986111211035002. Publisher PDF available through web text extraction (corrected August 2023); cached extract covers pp. 255–270. Replication obtained as author thesis chapter reproducing exact article title/authors/journal volume/pages, but chapter cites DOI 10.1080/15614263.2023.2249246 rather than supplied 10.1080/15614263.2022.2102494; discrepancy retained. Narrative success is authors' broad robustness verdict, not a statistical significance verdict.
